name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: This leg of the investigation finally confirms the sinister truth connecting the elusive tutor to Darkshire's records. Clerk Daltry successfully matches the handwriting found on the recovered documents to Stalvan Mistmantle, prompting an immediate report to Commander Althea Ebonlocke. It marks the moment the Night Watch's suspicions harden into undeniable fact.

sections.title: A Match in the Records
sections.body: After combing through distant manors, inns, and municipal archives across the human kingdoms, the fragmented trail returns to Darkshire's town hall. Clerk Daltry compares the bloodstained journal page against the signatures in the Town Registry. The result is unequivocal: the penmanship belongs to Stalvan Mistmantle, giving the Night Watch the hard evidence needed to treat the matter as an urgent local threat.

sections.title: The Night Watch's Suspicions
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke had harbored grim instincts regarding Stalvan from the start of the inquiry. Duskwood already buckles under the weight of feral worgen, skeletal undead, and lurking necromancers; an unaccounted-for murderer hiding within the shadows of the woods is a danger she cannot ignore. Receiving confirmation from Daltry validates her darkest fears and sets the Night Watch on course to locate and neutralize the recluse once and for all.

faq.answer: Clerk Daltry compared the bloodstained journal page against the signatures in Darkshire's Town Registry and confirmed that the handwriting was an exact match for Stalvan Mistmantle, just as Commander Ebonlocke suspected.

faq.q: Why does Commander Althea Ebonlocke care so much about Stalvan?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch, Darkshire's beleaguered militia. In a land already beset by terrors, she cannot allow a violent, shadowy figure with a dark past to remain loose and unaccounted for within Duskwood's borders.

faq.q: Where does this step take place?
faq.answer: This entire step takes place within the town of Darkshire. Clerk Daltry is stationed inside the town hall, while Commander Althea Ebonlocke can be found patrolling nearby along the town's central roads.

faq.q: What happens after reporting the handwriting match?
faq.answer: Once Commander Ebonlocke receives the confirmation from Clerk Daltry, the investigation turns toward actively hunting down Stalvan's current whereabouts in the haunted wilds of Duskwood.

Stalvan Mistmantle once taught at the Moonbrook schoolhouse and later worked as a private tutor to the children of the Flintridge family. The trail of his letters and journal pages leads from Moonbrook and Goldshire back to Duskwood, where he now lives as a dangerous recluse in the woods.

Because the events and accusations surrounding Stalvan occurred across different regions—including Moonbrook and Goldshire—official records were disjointed. Darkshire's civic registry held verified local samples that could definitively tie the foreign clues to the specific man.

angles.text: For Alliance investigators, unraveling Stalvan's trail demonstrates the vital cooperation required between Darkshire's battered leadership and wandering adventurers to keep the realm's southern territories secure.
Human players see the tragic decay of their own society reflected here, where respected tutors and rural towns alike slip quietly from civilization into madness and isolation.
